songLine: Staff only: The Gatekeeper, on strike, protection shuts doors; too tired to open them.
The Gatekeeper, overcompensating, too much protection suffocates; seven locks, one door, zero air.
reason: Parentheses unspeakable; article added so the two Gatekeeper cards sound like a matched pair.

songLine: The reviews are in: Inner Critic with the megaphone, failure is loud; a goblin with fresh batteries.
reason: Parenthetical prop turned into a spoken phrase.

cardName: Future Self: The One Who Left
songLine: Fortune booth: Future Self, the one who left, another path existed; glitchy suitcase, postcards from the timeline next door.
reason: Colon inside the name would be heard as a mini-opener; comma instead.

cardName: Future Self: The One Who Stayed
songLine: Future Self, the one who stayed, endurance becomes fate; same room, same chair, older.
Cosmic PowerPoint, broken, insight without clarity; slide one, everything. Slide two, error.
The Exit Sign that moves, leaving isn't simple; this way out. No, this way. No, this way.
reason: Parentheses unspeakable; article added for flow.

songLine: Therapist and Client, structure holds chaos; two chairs, I hold the frame, you keep the answers.
Seven-Day Witness, boring reveals truth; Monday, same. Tuesday, same. Thursday, oh.
reason: Numeral spelled out so Suno does not read 'seven dash'.

songLine: The Back Cover Manifesto, stay symbolic, stay theatrical; rabbit on the poster, paws up, curtain.
reason: Slash unspeakable; lore 'Stay symbolic stay theatrical' also gets a comma pause.
